name: grimmsnarl_ml_v29
policy: Retain v28's AlphaTCG-conditioned v25 ranker for ordinary races, mirrors, Alakazam, and pure Teal Mask Ogerpon. Use the synchronized 1220-rated v22 elite-teacher ranker for public walls, Mega Lopunny/Mega Froslass, and Teal Ogerpon plus the Applin/Hydrapple line. Preserve all deterministic v28 guards.

routes: public damage-immune wall or Neutralization Zone
Mega Lopunny ex or Mega Froslass ex line
Hydrapple ex, or Teal Mask Ogerpon plus Applin/Dipplin

wall_ranker.activation: public wall evidence; the same synchronized elite ranker also owns v29's Lopunny/Froslass and Hydrapple routes

target_pool.interpretation: directional small-sample evidence for a bounded challenger, not proof of a true 186 Elo gain

pure_ogerpon_negative_control.decision: retain v25; neither policy solves the Grass-weakness exchange

adrena_brain_option_audit.decision: no v29 override; the inferred 30-game missed-use lever was refuted by legal-option logs

policy_escalation.reason: The AlphaTCG default uses teacher code 3; enabling the legacy Froslass class switch would reintroduce v24's observationally refuted intervention.

validation.static_validation: PASS; 60 cards, 19 unique cards, zero warnings
validation.extracted_archive_import_smoke: PASS; agent callable, deck 60, all optional components loaded

promotion_contract.run_against: v28 control in the same ladder window
primary: opponent-rating-adjusted result in Mega Lopunny/Froslass and Hydrapple
promotion_contract.do_not_claim: teacher-forced action changes are not counterfactual wins; v29 is not proven stronger until paired ladder evidence

known_limits: Pure Teal Mask Ogerpon remains a structural Grass-weakness matchup and is intentionally unchanged.
The target-policy comparison is observational and small (31 v22/v25 games; p=0.244).
Hydrapple has only 8 v22/v25 games, so its direction cannot be estimated precisely.
The same-turn ordering differences in teacher-forced replay do not by themselves imply game value.
A stable rating gain cannot be guaranteed before a paired ladder run.
description: v28 plus measured elite-teacher routing for Mega Lopunny/Mega Froslass and Hydrapple, with pure Ogerpon and all proven v28 cells preserved.
